alpaca.openPaperAccount: Open your paper trading account: in the Alpaca dashboard, switch the account selector at the top to Paper Trading. Alpaca gives every account a paper account with simulated funds.
alpaca.generateKeys: Generate paper API keys: with Paper Trading selected, find the API Keys panel on the dashboard and click Generate New Key. Copy the API key and the secret - Alpaca shows the secret only once. Paper keys work only for the paper account.
alpaca.keepDashboardOpen: Keep the dashboard open - the fields below ask for both values.

settings.description: Leave fields blank to keep the stored values.
settings.label: Label

unsealed.title: Keys will be stored unencrypted
unsealed.description: Officer runs without a master key, so these API keys are written to its database in plain text. Anyone who can read the database or a backup can trade on this account. Set a master key to store them sealed.
unsealed.link: How to set a master key
unsealed.caution: A lost master key makes the database unopenable - back the key up before you set it.

access.title: Account access
access.feeRequired: Set a fee account first. {{provider}} charges fees that are not tied to orders; with several accounts on one connection Officer needs one account to book them on.

fee.title: Fee account
fee.description: {{provider}} fees are not tied to orders. On a connection shared by several accounts, they are all booked on this account.
